categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: due to significant demand the wait time for an ambulance in category 3 was in excess of 4 hours rather than the target 1 hour

reports.title: Oliver Shelley: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: The lack of a sepsis algorithm pathway to assist the emergency medical advisor (EMA) during 111/999 calls
Emergency Medical Advisors (EMA's), generally have no qualifications in medicine or nursing
concerns.hazard: misleading title of Emergency Medical Advisors

concerns.quote: Oliver's parents gave an extreme clear assessment of Oliver's condition and also informed the EMA that they were concerned it was meningitis
concerns.hazard: failure to recognise caller's meningitis concern

links.explanation: Both reports identify a missing sepsis detection tool in emergency call handling that could delay appropriate response.
